dedupe_keys.name: tramites de transito y transporte realizados ante la gerencia de seguridad vial de antioquia

description: Trámites de tránsito y transporte realizados ante la Gerencia de Seguridad Vial de Antioquia is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Gobernación de Antioquia, Antioquia. Contiene los datos de fecha, tipo de vehículo y tipo de trámite para los diferentes trámites de tránsito y transporte realizados ante la Gerencia de Seguridad Vial de Antioquia. Primera versión: Trámites realizados durante 2021. Segunda versión: Actualización datos a 31 de dic de 2024. Coverage: Gobernación de Antioquia, Antioquia. The portal files it under the publisher Gobernación de Antioquia, Antioquia. Its tags are tránsito, vial, movilidad, trámite. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Transporte. The portal shows 2025-03-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
